description: Works out a health clinic's care plan numbers from its own monthly counts: first visit → report, report → plan, first visit → plan, plan completed, renewal and reactivation. Given the clinic's own plan options and pay-per-visit price, it adds the price per visit of each option and its saving against paying per visit, largest option first. It never suggests visit counts, frequency, plan length or prices. Counts and prices only: never send patient names or records.

continued.description: Of those reassessed, patients who continued after the reassessment (new phase or maintenance): a count, not a percentage.

currency.description: Currency of the prices: EUR, GBP, USD or AUD. Without it, money is written as a plain number.

lapsed_messaged.description: Lapsed patients the clinic messaged to come back: a count, not a percentage.

pay_per_visit_price.description: What the clinic charges for one visit paid on its own, in the currency given: with plan_options, it gives each option's saving against paying per visit.

plan_options.description: The clinic's own plan options (one to five), as it already offers them: the visits each includes and its total price. Leave it out if the clinic has none: options are never suggested.

price.description: Total price of this option, in the currency given.

visits.description: Visits this option includes, as the clinic offers it: a whole number from 1.

reactivated.description: Of those lapsed patients messaged, patients who booked again: a count, not a percentage.

reassessed.description: Of those who started a plan, patients who reached the reassessment: a count, not a percentage.

started_plan.description: Of those, patients who started a plan, as the clinic defines it: a count, not a percentage.

visit_1.description: Patients whose visit 1 (the assessment) was in the month counted: a count, not a percentage.

visit_2.description: Of those, patients who came to visit 2 (the report of findings): a count, not a percentage.

name: calculate_care_plan_numbers

options.description: Largest first (by visits; ties in the order given)

pay_per_visit_total.description: The same visits paid one by one; null without pay_per_visit_price

saving.description: pay_per_visit_total minus price: negative when the option costs more than paying per visit

saving_percent.description: saving ÷ pay_per_visit_total in percent, to one decimal; null without a base

plans.description: The clinic's own plan options; null when none are given (the tool never suggests one)

display.description: The rate as written in the text

needs.description: The input counts a pending rate waits for

status.description: calculated from the counts given; pending while a count is missing (needs names it); no_base over a count of 0

value.description: The rate in percent, to one decimal; null when pending or with no base

reference.description: The patient retention skill's published reference (Spain, chiropractic): not a target

title: Calculate a clinic's care plan numbers
